claim: Replacing notes with the address book’s own read-only view silently deletes every note.
evidence: getNoteMap() returns Collections.unmodifiableMap(notes), a live view. Calling setNotes(book.getNoteMap()), resetData(book), or model.setAddressBook(model.getAddressBook()) reaches this.notes.clear() before putAll(notes), so the source map is already empty.

claim: The user guide incorrectly says notes are neither persisted nor undoable.
evidence: Lines 335 and 360 describe confirmation-only behavior and explicitly deny undo support. NoteCommand.execute now calls model.setNote(), isStateMutating() returns true, and LogicManager saves the address book after execution; JsonSerializableAddressBook now serializes notes.
